title: Puffco Peak Pro Onyx Joystick Cap
description:
Never stuck. Less maintenance. Always fun.

The Peak Pro Onyx Joystick Cap provides precise 360º directional airflow for more consistent heating, giving you bigger clouds and better flavour. Made of shatterproof stainless steel and silicone, the Joystick’s design is easy to clean and prevents reclaim from stopping your flow. And it’s fidget friendly.

Product Features:
– Made of shatterproof stainless steel and silicone
– Provides 360º directional airflow
– Compatible with the Peak Pro Vaporizer

What’s Included:
1 x Peak Pro Onyx Joystick Cap
